novelty_flags.label: Lemma frechet-covariance
novelty_flags.one_line: The lemma is exactly the sharp covariance rearrangement and comonotone/countermonotone attainment already stated in AronowGreenLee2014SharpVariance, Lemma 1; retain it only as background machinery, not a proposed contribution.

soundness_flags.label: Definitions Q(c), g_B(c), and ell_B(c)
soundness_flags.one_line: With c declared to range over all R, Q(c) need not be positive semidefinite and the stated nonnegative codomains of g_B(c) and ell_B(c) fail, notably for the algebraic zero surrogate when 0 is outside [c_L,c_U]; restrict moment claims to feasible c or define the surrogate separately as a signed algebraic criterion.

soundness_flags.label: ass:kappa-regularity in thm:plugin-correspondence
soundness_flags.one_line: Every B quantified by the theorem already lies in B_kappa, whose definition includes the same normalized eigenvalue inequality, so this listed hypothesis adds no condition and should be absorbed into the domain.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition certified-witness-open-dominance
soundness_flags.one_line: The proposition merely substitutes the two witness margins into thm:relative-open-persistence and restates Delta>0; make it an unnumbered corollary or fold it into the theorem rather than presenting it as a research result.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Relative-open strict-dominance claim
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Strict robust-versus-zero-surrogate dominance is not asserted universally; it is conditional on the separate full-correspondence separation and optimizer-slack witness construction.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: A relative-open dominance region is claimed only conditional on an explicit output of oeq:separated-lawful-witness with delta>0 and eta>0.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper specifies supplied-basis boundedness and nondegeneracy, uses i.i.d. potential-outcome pairs for ex ante basis choice, gives the covariance-dependent nonconvex objective, and proposes independence/zero covariance for the surrogate matrix.
The proposition gives consistency of sharp upper and lower regression-adjusted variance-bound plug-ins under outcome-model and integrability conditions.

source_verification_receipts.version: Economic Theory 13(2) (1999); publisher full text inaccessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The record reports continuity of the restricted-marginal correspondence, continuous optimizer values, and upper-hemicontinuity of optimizers; exact journal theorem text was not publicly inspectable.
The article describes branch-and-bound for bounded nonconvex quadratic objectives and constraints and states finite epsilon-global termination.
alphaBB constructs rigorous convex lower bounds using interval-Hessian information and provides convergence to arbitrarily close global minima for twice-differentiable constrained NLPs.
The paper characterizes admissible conservative quadratic variance bounds under arbitrary interference and complex designs and optimizes those bounds, rather than choosing a control-variate basis.
The paper studies distributionally robust stochastic optimization with uncertain dependence structures and derives tractable robust formulations for generic losses.
The article presents a randomization-based framework using known designs, exposure mappings, and inverse-probability-weighted estimators under general interference.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Restrict Q(c), g_B(c), and ell_B(c) to c in the feasible Fréchet interval, then introduce a separately typed signed zero-surrogate objective for A_0 when zero is infeasible.

Demote the published Fréchet lemma and the witness-to-persistence proposition to background/corollary status, leaving the robust reduction, certification OEQ, and pilot argmax result as the root contribution chain.

Upgrade the certified solver target with an explicit input-size model and a termination/complexity bound, or state precisely that it is a certified semialgebraic decision procedure rather than a generic branch-and-bound adaptation.

After repairing the typing, add a certified nondegenerate finite witness or a reproducible search artifact; this would convert the conditional dominance component from a plausible route into an empirically checkable field-level result.
